pageDescription: Integrate mikrouli into your scripts and AI agents via REST API or the hosted MCP server.
restAuthHeaderDesc: Pass your API key in the x-api-key request header on every call.
restKeyObtain: Obtain an mk_ key from the API Keys page after signing in.
restEndpointDesc: POST /api/urls with a JSON body containing the target URL.
restResponseDesc: The response is a PublicLink object. The shortUrl field is a 6-character slug (not a full URL). Build the shareable link by prepending the base URL: https://mikrou.li/ + shortUrl.
mcpSectionDesc: Connect an MCP-aware agent harness to the hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint.
mcpAuthNote: Authenticate with the same x-api-key header as the REST API.
mcpToolDesc: The create_short_link tool returns the full usable link (e.g. https://mikrou.li/abc123) as its text output.
